title: imagebuildah.stageExecutor.getCreatedBy(): resolve args in "from=" values
body:
#### What type of PR is this?

/kind bug

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

When looking for the digest of an image that we mounted using a "from=" option in a "RUN --mount" flag, resolve arguments in the name of where we're getting it from before assuming that we can find an entry by that name in a map that holds pointers to structures, and read one of the fields in that structure.

#### How to verify it

New integration test!

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

#### Special notes for your reviewer:

Follows up on #6110, which was included in 1.40.  We might want to backport this to branches that contain #5691 (included in 1.39), which is where this crash first appeared.
